# SK0213 — The namespace declaration is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would use the configured file-scoped or block-scoped namespace form.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | 10.0 |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Namespace form is a tree rewrite with trivia and using-directive ownership consequences. The arrangement pipeline performs it together with using placement and verifies the combined result reaches a fixed point.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
namespace Sample {
    class C { }
}
```

Write:

```csharp
namespace Sample;

class C { }
```

## When it does not fire

Files whose directives, multiple namespaces or language version make the conversion unsafe are left unchanged.

## Configuration

- `csharp_style_namespace_declarations`
